'''Keeling''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time Question">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in an imperial front that served as [[Keeling's listening post]], where after recovering stolen intelligence reports with [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] slicing signatures, he sent an Imperial to destroy the Republic listening post, from which Imperial communications were intercepted.<ref name="SWTOR" /> The [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]] had a [[Shadow Syndicate safe house|safe house]] within Keeling's listening post.

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Keeling appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa and starts the mission "The Walls Have Ears."
